chunks: But those who deny Our signs and disdain them, shall belong to Hell, where they will abide for ever.
ai.seo_question: Who are the inhabitants of Hell according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual cause of eternal damnation: the intellectual rejection of divine signs (Ayat) coupled with the spiritual arrogance (Istikbar) that prevents humility. It underscores that mere disbelief is compounded by the prideful refusal to submit, marking them as the quintessential inhabitants of Hellfire who remain therein perpetually.
